about: Every capture of an outside page kept for this site, by address. A record is at evidence/<id>.json and its page at evidence/<id>.html; the list of every capture of an address, with its hashes, is in evidence/<source>/index.json (source = the first part of the id). The screenshots of sources that may be shown are in the display vault (data/vaults.json, a published read key); everything raw is in a private, packed vault. "changed" compares the visible text with the capture before.
